summary.summary: MALLING & CO MARKETS AS is a private limited company operating in Eiendomsmegling og andre formidlingstjenester for eiendom. Latest accounts (2025): revenue NOK 3.8m, annual result NOK 22.3m. Annual accounts available for 2012-2025 (14 years). Detailed records only available as PDFs. Revenue shrinking (-48.8% YoY). Baseline run, no prior version to compare against (run none). Unknowns: employees (registry returned no employee count); hiring (no job sources were checked).
